customManagers.description: Release tags and asset SHA-256 sums in scripts/install.sh. One dependency per table row, so each architecture's digest is updated.

packageRules.description: Unreal Agent and nono (scripts/install.sh) and GitHub Actions: wait 3 days after a release, then Renovate merges minor and patch updates once Install check passes. A merged change to action.yml or scripts/ publishes the next patch release (release.yml).
